summary: Tests that the English and Hindi presentation text for the experience pages has the expected wording.
purpose: Catches accidental changes to key page wording in both languages.
why: Likely reason: wording changes can break the Hindi copy silently, so these checks guard it. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Loads the English and Hindi presentation text and checks a few key phrases: the landing title, the review verification label, the Hindi core records label, and a Hindi traceability word.
inputs: Presentation text returned for each language.
outputs: Pass or fail for the localization test.
risks: Exact text checks break when copy is improved on purpose, so updates must change the test too.
debug: If a check fails, compare the expected phrase with the copy in the localization file.
